principle: Harden and generalize the existing Scientific Knowledge Catalog, Campaign Engine and validators. Do not create a parallel architecture layer.
productionGate: Continuous scientific production must remain paused until every P0 recommendation is implemented and validated together.

recommendations.action: Replace the hepatic-specific execution path with one generic campaign execution contract inside the existing Campaign Engine.
acceptance: A second fixture campaign runs without editing catalog-builder, execution, validation or report source files.
P7 remains a golden-master fixture, not the implementation template for every campaign.
No new public or product layer is introduced.

recommendations.action: Bind campaign identity and execution identity to immutable selection material rather than group ordinal alone.
acceptance: Changing batch membership changes the campaign revision or selection digest.
An execution record cannot suppress a newly inserted node unless its exact selection material was executed.
Idempotent replay of identical material returns the same execution result.

recommendations.action: Make the existing governance gate mandatory for every scientific mutation and fail closed for unknown operations.
acceptance: Unknown operations are rejected.
Authorization uses the supplied catalog and returns that catalog's digest.
Enrichment requires membership in the exact selected campaign.
Priority, coverage policy, dependencies and blockingNodes are checked.
No campaign writer can be invoked without a governance decision token bound to the selection digest.

recommendations.action: Recompute and cross-check status, readiness, coverage, provenance counts and referenced endpoints from authoritative graph records.
acceptance: READY without sources is rejected.
READY without assertions is rejected when the node type requires assertions.
READY with insufficient coverage is rejected.
Every provenance source, assertion and EvidenceLink ID resolves.
The catalog digest is recomputed and checked.
The seven P8 robustness mutations produce the expected failure or explicit documentary exception.

recommendations.action: Define one explicit global scheduling order and make gap/status semantics consistent with that order.
policyQuestionsToResolve: Whether any source gap OR assertion gap is sufficient for enrichment.
Whether PROJECTED is allowed to hide incomplete scientific coverage.
Whether domain campaigns supersede child-node campaigns or coexist with them.
How failed or insufficient campaigns re-enter the queue without starving other nodes.
acceptance: The highest eligible score is selected first, with a deterministic tie-breaker.
Blocked nodes are never selected.
Every incomplete eligible node has a documented path to selection or a documented permanent exclusion reason.
No candidate can be selected forever after repeated failure without retry/backoff state.

recommendations.action: Keep P7 exact counts and digests as a historical golden master, but remove them from the generic current-state validity gate.
acceptance: P7 replay still verifies its original counts and digests.
A second valid campaign increases totals without modifying generic validator code.
Generic validators check invariants, uniqueness, provenance, deltas and append-only execution history rather than a single expected total.

recommendations.action: Add an append-only lifecycle to the existing campaign execution registry with atomic transition guards.
acceptance: Concurrent execution of the same selection is rejected or deduplicated.
A partial failure leaves the previous catalog digest authoritative.
Retry increments attempt and preserves earlier evidence.
A completed transition can be replayed without duplicate graph records.

recommendations.action: Define which directed relation sets must be acyclic and validate them consistently in selection, authorization and execution.
acceptance: Dependency, prerequisite and blocking cycles are either rejected or explicitly modeled with a non-schedulable resolution state.
Successor and replacement lifecycle relations receive their own coherent cycle policy.
Tests include non-empty dependency graphs, blocked priorities and unblocking transitions.

recommendations.action: Separate documentary reference coverage from resolved scientific source coverage in planning and readiness rules.
acceptance: sourceCoverage used for scientific campaigns is based on resolved scientific sources.
Historical or documentary refs remain visible in a separate dimension.
A node with only unresolved refs cannot become scientific provenance ready.

recommendations.action: Index EvidenceLinks by ID and assertion, and replace queue operations with linear-time traversals.
acceptance: Catalog construction does not call a linear evidence search for each evidence ID.
Graph validation remains near-linear on flat and deep 5000-node fixtures.
A benchmark includes at least 5000 nodes and 50000 EvidenceLinks/assertions before continuous production is opened.

recommendations.action: Keep one canonical machine artifact and derive verbose reports on demand or split the catalog into stable indexed partitions.
acceptance: No scientific data is duplicated as an independently authoritative registry.
Diffs remain reviewable when one campaign is appended.
Projection evaluations and readiness explanations can be regenerated deterministically.

recommendations.action: Define an explicit content-digest policy for sources when lawful and technically possible.
acceptance: A null content digest remains an explicit limitation.
Archived or locally retained lawful source material is byte-digested.
Remote-only sources retain metadata and retrieval evidence without claiming byte-level replay.

recommendations.action: Document whether a medical specialty is represented by Domain or warrants a generic Specialty class based on multiple concrete domains.
acceptance: No class is added for a single example.
The chosen representation supports modality, manufacturer, technology and biomarker additions without campaign-engine changes.

recommendations.action: Separate immutable historical phase reports from a current operational status report and consolidate redundant validator wrappers where useful.
acceptance: Historical P6/P7 reports are labeled snapshots.
Current reports do not claim no commit after the audited commit exists.
Layer-specific validators remain available for diagnosis while the default industrial gate emits a compact summary.

minimumIndustrialAcceptanceSuite: Two different fixture campaigns execute through the same generic path.
Campaign identity drift and retry behavior are tested.
All P8 provenance/readiness mutations are rejected.
A non-empty dependency DAG is scheduled correctly and blocked nodes are excluded.
5000 nodes and 50000 assertions/EvidenceLinks complete within an explicit performance budget.
All protected public and product surfaces remain unchanged.
